subject: pharmacology
title: Cytotoxic Anticancer VI: Anthracyclines, Cumulative Cardiotoxicity and Dexrazoxane

steps.tx: **Anthracyclines** (doxorubicin, daunorubicin, epirubicin, idarubicin) poison topoisomerase II, intercalate DNA and generate iron catalysed free radicals, a triple mechanism billing the class crown toxicity: cumulative dose related cardiomyopathy. Doxorubicin's red urine (harmless colour, coached), vesicant extravasation necrosis, marrow and mucositis, and radiation recall complete the portrait every oncology trainee must recite without notes.
steps.say: Doxorubicin is red, vesicant and cumulatively cardiotoxic; the heart keeps its lifetime ledger.

left.title: Mechanism triple
points: Topo II beta in cardiomyocytes implicates the heart

steps.tx: **Cumulative cardiotoxicity** follows a dose curve examiners quote: heart failure incidence climbs steeply beyond 450 to 550 mg per square metre of doxorubicin, lower with chest radiation, age extremes and cardiac disease, monitored by serial ejection fraction (echo or MUGA, strain and biomarkers refining) with stop rules, and mitigated by liposomal formulations, infusion schedules, epirubicin's kinder ratio and dexrazoxane in defined settings. Anthracycline cardiomyopathy is dilated, often irreversible, and preventable mainly by arithmetic.
steps.say: Count milligrams per square metre like radiation dose; the ejection fraction is read before symptoms.

nodes.label: Baseline ejection fraction and risk inventory
Stop rules at EF fall or dose ceiling

steps.tx: **Dexrazoxane** serves two rescues from one molecule: an iron chelator and topoisomerase II catalytic inhibitor that protects cardiomyocytes when given before anthracyclines (10 to 1 dose ratio, metastatic breast and high cumulative dose settings, fenced by historical response and second malignancy debates) and rescues anthracycline extravasation as a three day infusion started within six hours, replacing surgery for most leaks.
steps.say: Dexrazoxane guards the heart before the dose and the skin within six hours of the leak.

left.title: Cardioprotection role
points: High cumulative dose and metastatic settings
Iron chelation plus topo II beta protection

right.title: Extravasation role
points: Start within 6 hours, daily for 3 days
Cold compresses (held around infusions per protocol)
Surgery avoided in most treated leaks

steps.tx: **Liposomal doxorubicin** re engineers distribution rather than mechanism: pegylated liposomes leak preferentially into tumour vasculature and away from cardiac capillaries, trading cardiomyopathy down and hand foot syndrome and mucositis up, serving Kaposi sarcoma, ovarian and myeloma niches where cardiac risk or prior anthracycline exposure fences the conventional drug. Epirubicin and idarubicin adjust the same trade by chemistry instead of packaging.
steps.say: Liposomes move doxorubicin from heart to tumour and bill the palms instead.

left.title: Liposomal trade
points: Hand foot syndrome and mucositis rise

right.title: Chemical cousins
points: Epirubicin: higher dose ceiling per cardiotoxicity
Mitoxantrone: anthracenedione, blue urine, cardiac ledger kept

steps.tx: **Anthracycline combinations** anchor curative regimens whose survivorship wrote modern cardio oncology: CHOP in lymphoma, AC in breast, 7 plus 3 in AML (daunorubicin days against cytarabine's week), ABVD's doxorubicin in Hodgkin lymphoma, each with ejection fraction gates and late cardiac clinics following survivors, especially childhood survivors screened lifelong by cumulative dose and radiation fields.
steps.say: Curative anthracycline regimens created cardio oncology; childhood survivors are screened for life.

left.title: Anchor regimens
points: CHOP and R CHOP in lymphomas
AC then taxane sequences in breast

right.title: Survivorship system
points: Childhood survivor guidelines by dose and radiation
Pregnancy cardiac assessment in exposed survivors
Heart failure treated conventionally when found

steps.tx: **Bleomycin** pair by organ: bleomycin (inactivated by hydrolase absent in lung and skin) bills pulmonary fibrosis by cumulative units with oxygen caution in anaesthesia forever after, testicular and Hodgkin careers (ABVD), and flagellate dermatitis; dactinomycin serves paediatric tumours with vesicant and radiation recall ledgers. Name the drug, name the organ, again.
steps.say: Bleomycin bills lungs and skin where its inactivating enzyme is absent; oxygen respects it forever.

left.title: Bleomycin portrait
points: Pulmonary fibrosis cumulative, monitored by DLCO

right.title: Dactinomycin footnote
points: Hepatic sinusoidal injury in Wilms protocols

steps.tx: **Mitomycin and streptozocin** close the shelf: mitomycin (bioreductive alkylator like) serves anal and bladder (intravesical) niches billing delayed marrow and haemolytic uraemic syndrome at cumulative doses, streptozocin's glucose guided pancreatic islet tropism treats neuroendocrine tumours billing kidneys and violent emesis. The remaining agents are niche by design; examinations test the niche and the organ, never the catalogue.
steps.say: Minor cytotoxics are niche plus organ; learn the pairing, skip the catalogue.

steps.tx: **Cardio oncology** gathers this lesson with the targeted batch's cardiac ledgers (trastuzumab's reversible dysfunction, kinase inhibitor hypertension and QT): baseline risk, serial imaging, biomarker assistance, cardioprotective therapy (ACE inhibitors and beta blockers debated prophylactically, prescribed therapeutically), and the curative intent calculus that sometimes accepts monitored cardiac risk rather than surrendering cure, decided jointly and documented.
steps.say: Sometimes cure is worth monitored cardiac risk; that decision is joint, imaged and documented.

nodes.label: Baseline cardiac risk and EF documented
Dysfunction: heart failure therapy, hold or continue jointly
Survivorship cardiac clinic by exposure tier
